specification.execution_instructions:
Run the new autonomous joint design-and-control study. Read the original task via rl.frozen_task, all scoped historical evidence, specification and current budgets explicitly with evidence_read. The already passing reference design is history, not a new joint optimization achievement. Genuinely execute a supported joint length-and-motion optimization via research_plan mechanics with task_gap or task_gap_with_effort; explain task relevance, mathematical assumptions, relaxations and why your chosen integration method/discretization suit the intended use. All supported mathematical accuracy choices are yours; time alone does not justify the coarsest model. At most two solves, each6600s outer cap, research_work_v1, existing1000 iterations; a second solve needs a reason from the first result, never duplicate merely to consume allowance. Read returned result and linked progress/request/trajectory, preserve solver convergence versus numerical feasibility versus independent verification. If no candidate, cite last stage, no infeasibility claim. Handoff a returned candidate through existing propose mechanics_source. Choose whether to verify (at most2 existing replay operations,600s each), rank/inspect or explore control directly, keeping unverified references labeled unverified. Mathematical integration and MuJoCo acceptance are different evidence.
Choose direct/residual RL or actually admitted NMPC using evidence and remaining budget. NMPC prefers exact matched existing complete timing, at most4 executions including confirmations,1800s cap; first-use is unavailable because the existing synchronous path cannot enforce the authorized hard outer cap. No invented calibration or automatic switching. Residual needs an advertised compatible runnable reference; compatibility proves no numerical accuracy. Training at most3 trials,400000 requested actions/1800 active seconds per trial,1200000 actions/3600 seconds cumulative. Choose settings/rewards and allocations yourself; whole rollouts round DOWN and requested/effective allocations stay recorded. Program waits outside model calls. Query terminal status, explicitly evidence_read training_summary_reference, then independently evaluate an eligible published checkpoint by exact name; explicitly read result. With no eligible checkpoint, read actual failure stage/consumption/evidence and choose another authorized action or STOP. Never evaluate missing policy, substitute checkpoints or automatically restart. Decisions to change controller/reward/design or stop are yours, bounded by prior evidence.
At most7 RL episodes including two fresh confirmations; at most1 existing physical diagnostic60s/one supported physical step. Aggregate numerical18000s, elapsed21600s including900s delivery,80 provider requests including failed requests/corrections,200 public operations,16 protected provider requests. Ceilings are not targets and cannot override reservations. No transferred historical credit.
Original frozen task: target[.29,.035,.19]m, zero initialization,.35s,.01s control,.0005s MuJoCo,.01m terminal/holding error,.02m/s holding speed,inclusive samples30-35. Rewards/mathematics cannot change these. Freeze a complete passing development execution via research_plan action confirm selected_execution (first call also executes one confirmation); call twice with SAME selected_execution for two fresh post-selection episodes, read each result. Ordinary research_rl evaluate is development, never confirmation. Retain any failed confirmation and stop unconfirmed; no retry for success. Invalid execution is unmeasured and needs scoped defect resolution, not a scientific failure or automatic repetition. STOP cites every new experiment/training summary after explicit reads and terminal queries, records remaining objectives and evidence-based next_step. Honest scientific failure or incomplete objectives can STOP. No robustness/generalization/global optimum/superiority/root-cause claims; accepted STOP is not success. Send only authorized nonsecret data.
